# documentation-actions

> Reusable GitHub Actions and workflows for LLazyEmail Docusaurus docs and awesome-list repos.

## Docs

- README.md — inventory, badges, usage snippets
- AGENTS.md — rules for AI agents
- CONTRIBUTING.md — PR conventions
- examples/ — thin caller workflows

## Actions (paths)

Composite actions live under actions/<name>/action.yml.
Reusable workflows live under .github/workflows/reusable-*.yml.

Pin LLazyEmail/documentation-actions@v1 after the first release.
